Class ShardMergeCli

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.reportaggregate.ShardMergeCli
public final class ShardMergeCli extends Object
CLI entry point merging N shard blob directories into one Allure result set plus a speedboard HTML and flaky-clustering summary. The merge logic itself (ShardMerger) lives in shaft-doctor so it can also be called directly by shaft-mcp's report_merge_shards tool without a circular module dependency (report-aggregate already depends on both shaft-doctor and shaft-mcp). Usage: 
java -cp report-aggregate.jar com.shaft.reportaggregate.ShardMergeCli \
    --output target/merged-report \
    target/shard-blobs/1 target/shard-blobs/2 target/shard-blobs/3
